title: The original Apple TV 4K from 2017 is now officially "vintage"
description: The smart streaming box/stick market is a bit weird for sure. There are all sorts of options out there, but each with distinct problems and limitations. Generic Android boxes are plentiful and can be powerful, but often offer a suboptimal software experience and format and technology support. There are cheap and easily available reputable options out there like Amazon's Firestick line, though that might be getting even more locked down with the move to Vega OS. Walmart has its "onn" line, but it is kind of US-only. Anyone actually serious about this device either swears by the Nvidia Shield...

title: Huawei Watch D3 in for review
description: Huawei's unique line of health-obsessed Watch D series' latest model is the Watch D3, and it's better in almost every way compared to its predecessor (review here). We'll get to that, but first, let's unbox it. You get a similar haul to the D2, but here too there are improvements. The magnetic wireless charging puck ends in a USB-C connection (finally), not USB-A like last year. You get an M-sized strap with a built-in airbag for blood pressure measurements, a wrist circumference ruler, and the watch itself. Huawei made some noticeable improvements to the Watch D2. The new model has...

title: Deals: Big discounts hit flagship phones from Samsung, Apple and Google
description: While Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days have wrapped up, discounts are still available on several smartphones. In fact, some devices that received few or no notable discounts during the sale are now available at reduced prices. Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra, Apple’s iPhone 17 Pro lineup, and the entire Google Pixel 11 series are among the phones on sale this weekend. The latest Samsung Galaxy Z foldables have also been discounted. The Galaxy S26 Ultra and the Galaxy S26+ are both available with good discounts. The Ultra receives up to £450 off, whereas the 512GB variant of the Galaxy S26+ is...

title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ or Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra?
description: Last year, the global tablet market was up 8.5% in Q1 as people started to replace devices they bought during the pandemic. Apple led the quarter with 13.7 million units shipped, up 14.0%, while Samsung was around half that with 6.6 million units shipped, down 5.2%. Samsung usually starts shipping its new flagship tablets in late Q3 (the Tab S11 models were available in September) or early Q4 (the Tab S12 series launched earlier this week), so shipments declining by 5.2% in Q1 was a bad look for the Tab S11 slates. So, now our attention turns to the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra – the Ultra...

title: The vivo X Fold6 powers advanced productivity features with India's biggest battery in a foldable
description: As folding technology matures, the focus has shifted from perfecting the hinge to slimming things down and now battery life has emerged as a key differentiating factor for foldables - the tablet-like multitasking, media consumption and gaming experience enabled by the larger screen put extra strain on the battery. The vivo X Fold6 is a productivity powerhouse with its large 8.02” main display, advanced multitasking, cross-platform features - plus India’s biggest battery in the foldable category, so that users can get an uncompromised smartphone experience. It has a 6,900mAh battery...

title: Weekly poll results: the vivo X Fold6 is hot, but its price can singe your wallet
description: As if foldables weren’t expensive enough, the skyrocketing costs of memory chips raised their prices even further – and that’s a problem for the vivo X Fold6. Not just for it, of course, the other foldables that it is competing with are in the same boat. Still, even among those who want a foldable phone, the largest contingent is people wishing for a price cut. In last week’s poll, we listed several price points for the X Fold6 from around Europe. Alas, its launch came too late to participate in the Prime Day sale this week, but some discounts will come. That said, don’t expect...

title: Xiaomi Watch S5 review
description: Introduction, unboxing People love the Xiaomi Watch S models and with good reason. They're affordable (€150 from Amazon), they're feature-rich and capable, but probably more important than anything else, they're great-looking. Model five is no different and, this editor argues, is even prettier than before, making it even more desirable. There's a noticeable uptick in refinement and perceived quality and durability with this year's model. It's ditched the interchangeable bezel of the previous model, which at least means you won't lose it. But don't worry, there are different bezels...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 might finally introduce DC dimming
description: We already heard word that Samsung Display is gearing up to start Galaxy S27 display manufacturing soon. That might have already happened; hence, these new leaks might be perfectly plausible. Apparently, the S27 Pro and S27 Ultra will be the first Samsung smartphones to offer DC dimming. That sounds like it can’t possibly be true, and yet a quick search later – indeed, even the Galaxy S26 Ultra relies on traditional PWM to adjust its brightness. Simplifying things a bit, in case you don’t know what we are talking about, PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) is the traditional way of...

title: Deals: Some Galaxy and Pixel phones kept their Prime Day prices - no Prime required now, though
description: Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days only lasted two days and there were some really good deals to be had for Prime subscribers. But that is over, so today we will look at no-Prime deals and, as it turns out, many phones kept their Prime Day prices. The good news is that these deals don’t require a Prime subscription. The bad news is that some phones did go back up in price. Starting with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, it goes for $1,700 for the 256GB model and $1,900 for the 512GB one. These are the exact same prices that we saw during Prime Big Deal Days, except now you don’t even need Prime....

title: Google starts teasing the Fitbit Edge, reveals its launch date
description: Google's next fitness tracker, the Fitbit Edge, leaked earlier this month, and then we also got rumored pricing for it as well as its full specs a few days later. Now, Google has finally acknowledged the existence of the device, and started teasing it on X, where it also revealed the Edge's launch date: October 12. title: Oppo Find N7's camera and display details surface
description: The Oppo Find N7 is expected in Q1 2027, possibly March, like its predecessor, the Find N6. While Oppo hasn't revealed anything about the Find N7, reliable tipster Digital Chat Station has shared some details. DCS says that the Oppo Find N7 will be powered by a 2nm chipset and feature a 7.6" screen with a seamless hinge solution. In comparison, the Find N6's cover display measured 6.62" while the folding display measured 8.12". A previous rumor claimed the Oppo Find N7 will have a wide form-factor like the Apple iPhone Duo, with its cover screen measuring 5.5" and folding screen measuring...

title: This is when the Infinix GT 50 Pro is finally launching in India
description: Infinix launched the GT 50 Pro back in April, but for some reason it still hasn't made the device available in India. That will thankfully change very soon. Following a brief teaser campaign, today the company has officially revealed the phone's launch date in India: October 27. Unfortunately, pricing for the device will probably only be revealed on that day. While you wait, you can check out our comprehensive in-depth review of the Infinix GT 50 Pro here. The handset comes with a 6.78-inch AMOLED screen with 1208x2644 resolution, a 144Hz refresh rate, and 4,500-nit peak brightness,...

title: Deals: vivo X Fold6 arrives, Galaxy S26 Ultra price remains low, iPhone 17 series on sale
description: The Prime Big Deal Days sale must have gone well as a lot of smartphones are showing as “out of stock” on Amazon – and for those that are still available, supplies are limited, so their prices went back up. We still managed to find a few good offers, but we’ll kick things off with a new release. The vivo X Fold6 was released in China back in July. Now, October marks its global release. The phone is very expensive - there’s no sugarcoating it - but it’s also one of the premier foldables this year. In our review, we called it “arguably the most complete large foldable currently on the...

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Hasselblad teleconverter kit unboxing and hands-on
description: The Oppo Find X10 series is going global on October 21, and we've already brought you guys a quick first look and unboxing of both the Find X10 and the Find X10 Pro Max. Now, we're taking a quick look at the Hasselblad Teleconverter Kit for the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max. It comes in a large and heavy box, but only features six items: the teleconverter lens, a MagSafe-enabled case, a lens mounting plate (for the case), a nice little strap, a carrying pouch, and a tripod collar. The strap uses quick-release clips that attach to the case, but can detach whenever you like. We love the...

title: OnePlus plans on launching two flagships in India, here's when
description: OnePlus is unveiling the OnePlus 16 in China on October 12, and the Ace 7 may join it or launch soon afterwards. Today a tipster over on X has revealed that the company is planning to launch two new flagship smartphones in India, either in December or in "early 2027". One of them will be the OnePlus 16R, which, if history repeats itself, will be heavily based on the Ace 7, if not a full rebrand of it. The Ace 7 / OnePlus 16R is expected to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC and sport a 6.78-inch flat OLED display with a "1.5K" resolution and a 185Hz refresh rate, a 200MP main...

title: Nothing's CMF is launching new products next week
description: Nothing's CMF sub-brand is on its way to becoming an independent Indian company, but that transition hasn't stopped it from churning out new products. Case in point: CMF has just announced that it will be launching two new products next week, on Monday, October 12, to be specific. Here's a teaser video. These will be two speakers. The CMF Speaker S and the CMF Speaker M. Obviously, the former should be a smaller version, while the latter will be bigger, given the naming scheme used here. The teaser image above shows a design that's very recognizable as a CMF...

title: HMD Pulse 2T Pro specs and images leak showing a dot matrix rear display
description: At the beginning of September, the HMD Pulse 2 Pro got prematurely listed by a Swiss retailer, and that revealed its specs. The phone is still not official, but in the meantime we have a new leak from a reliable source of HMD-related information, and this one is all about the HMD Pulse 2T Pro - note the "T" in the name. This device will allegedly sport a 6.78-inch OLED screen with FHD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, and it will be powered by the MediaTek Helio G100 SoC, paired with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. title: Google is working on HDR emoji for Chat
description: An APK teardown of the latest version of Gmail revealed that Google is looking to bring HDR emoji to its Chat app. That’s the Google Hangouts successor, which is part of the Google Workspace suite, for those outside the loop on Google software. A specific code string in the newest Gmail build hints at “display-supported emoji in high dynamic range (HDR) with enhanced brightness and contrast”. This feature is simply titled HDR emoji and will likely feature brighter emoji characters with higher contrast for easier legibility. This could be exclusive to custom emoji symbols but the code...

title: SpaceX buys spectrum for Starlink to become a full-fledged US mobile carrier
description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has just acquired up to 14MHz of paired spectrum in the 800MHz band nationwide in the US, from Grain Management. Musk says this is "the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America". So the aim here is clear. Use Starlink satellites to provide mobile phone coverage outdoors, and this 800MHz spectrum to provide indoor coverage. Most existing smartphones already support this band. Starlink Mobile will also use its existing global 2GHz mid-band spectrum for high-speed, high-capacity coverage in the US (mainly...

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27.2 beta receives AT&T carrier update
description: Apple has released an emergency carrier bundle update for iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T running iOS 27.2 beta. The update has version 72.0.3 and comes a week after Apple released carrier update 72.1 for iOS 27.0 users, while devices running iOS 27.2 beta remained on 72.0.2. [#InlinePriceWidget,14716,1#] Some iPhone 18 Pro Max users on the AT&T network have faced multiple issues, including losing network access for calls, texts, and data, and seeing "SOS" in the phone's status bar.
